lines.en: The savanna is wide; my hooves are light.

lines.zh: 我走在金合欢的影子里。
lines.en: I walk in the shade of the acacia.
The grass tips prick, but they smell sweet.

lines.zh: 族群的脚印在身后延伸。
lines.en: The herd's tracks trail out behind me.
When the wind moves, I want to run.
Soft steps, so the lion cannot hear.
I always walk on the outside of the herd.
I passed through this grass yesterday.
Dry grass crackles under my hooves.
My four legs move before my brain.
We take the long way around the bushes.
I count my herdmates as we walk.
The sun bakes my back fur hot.
Walking as a herd keeps me calm.

lines.zh: 这四条细腿跑起来才稳。
lines.en: These four thin legs are steady at a run.

lines.zh: 草原的风一来，我就想跑。
lines.en: When the savanna wind comes, I want to run.
The wind over the grass is wrong today.

lines.zh: 慢些，尘土扬起来会惊群。
lines.en: Slow down — kicked-up dust spooks the herd.

lines.zh: 我踩在草原上，轻得没声音。
lines.en: I step on the savanna, lighter than a sound.

lines.zh: 我头上这对角，跑起来沉。
lines.en: These horns weigh on me when I run.

lines.zh: 草原上，我一跳就换了方向。
lines.en: On the savanna, one bound changes my course.
Don’t step on this new grass.

lines.zh: 草又长高一寸，够得着了。
lines.en: The grass grew an inch — now I can reach it.
Run and pause — that’s how I stay alive.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上跑得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow runs ahead of me on the grass.

lines.zh: 蹄尖轻轻点地，几乎没声。
lines.en: Hooves touch light, almost silent.
My ears turn toward the sound first.
The grass is dry; it chews like paper.
I lift my head, then lower it again.
Something moved in the distance.
My horns are small, but I must keep them.
I count clouds and forget to graze.
My tail flicks away a fly.
Standing long, my legs tremble.
This mouthful is sweeter than the last.
I wait for someone to cry run.
Something rustles in the tall grass.
I lift my eyes; the sky still looks fine.
I slow my breath, yet my heart races.
We take turns keeping watch.

lines.zh: 鬣狗的味道在风里，我僵住。
lines.en: Hyena scent on the wind and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄刨了两下干土。
lines.en: I paw the dry dirt twice.

lines.zh: 同伴打了个响鼻，我跟着抬头。
lines.en: A herdmate snorts; I lift my head too.
There is not enough grass here for a herd.
When I stop, my ears turn first.

lines.zh: 草原上的小个子，跳得很高。
lines.en: The small one on the savanna jumps high.
I’m sunning my back; don’t startle me.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上又长一格。
lines.en: My shadow grows another block across the grass.

lines.zh: 我站着吃草，腿永远准备跑。
lines.en: I graze standing, legs always ready to run.

lines.zh: 站着也得留一条腿准备跑。
lines.en: Even standing, one leg stays ready to run.
One grass blade twitches and I am gone.

lines.zh: 草原上跑起来，尘土跟着我。
lines.en: Dust follows me across the savanna.

lines.zh: 远处谁在砍树，一声一声的。
lines.en: Someone is chopping far off, thud after thud.

lines.zh: 草原上，我一跳就是老远。
lines.en: On the savanna, one jump carries me far.
The grass is tenderer by the termite mound.
Something snakes through beneath the grass.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水，我抿一口。
lines.en: I sip dew from the grass blades.

lines.zh: 草原上一有影子，我先跳开。
lines.en: Any shadow on the savanna and I spring away.
One blade of grass moves, and my head comes up.

lines.zh: 草原的日头晒得草发甜。
lines.en: The savanna sun makes the grass sweet.

lines.zh: 我在数自己腿上的年轮。
lines.en: I am counting the rings on my legs.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，耳朵还在转。
lines.en: I pause, but my ears keep turning.
You stand too close; step back a little.
You are no lion; should I trust that?

lines.zh: 我看见你手里的东西了。
lines.en: I see what is in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我绷紧了腿。
lines.en: Your shadow makes my legs tense.
I stare at you until you leave.
When you smile, I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 我眼睛大，是为了看清危险。
lines.en: My eyes are big to spot danger early.
Are you a hunter, or a passerby?
My herdmates are watching you too.
Do not reach out; we are not close yet.

lines.zh: 你闻起来不像草原的东西。
lines.en: You do not smell like the savanna.
I have your face in my memory, human.

lines.zh: 你身上有砍树后的木味。
lines.en: You smell of freshly cut wood.
Your legs shake — are you afraid of me?
Not too close — I kick.

lines.zh: 我先看你的影子，再看你。
lines.en: I look at your shadow first, then you.
Did the wind bring you?

lines.zh: 你也有两只眼，跟我一样。
lines.en: You have two eyes, same as me.
Are you a seed or a bug?
Thin legs, but I jump far.
On the savanna, my ears go up first.

lines.zh: 草原上一点动静，我就跳开。
lines.en: One stir on the savanna and I spring away.
Turn slowly — don’t spook the herd.
So you're the one Gazelle mentioned.
Ouch! My legs nearly gave out.
That one landed on my shoulder.
I am bleeding; I must get away.

lines.zh: 我的步子乱了，得重新起步。
lines.en: My stride is broken; I must start again.
The pain pins my ears flat.
I should run; I know I should.
Nothing is broken; I can still stand.
You strike faster than a lion.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就跑不动了。
lines.en: One more and I will not be able to run.
I have memorized the way out.
Just a graze, I can still leap.
My legs buckle, so I spring away first.
It hurts from hoof to shoulder.
I’m still standing — all four legs steady.
On the savanna I run fastest.

lines.zh: 我这细腿，跑得比疼得快。
lines.en: These thin legs run faster than they hurt.
Sixteen points of life, all in my legs.

lines.zh: 年轮上又添一道，草原太硬。
lines.en: Another ring added; the savanna is hard ground.
Ow — my flank.
Blood drips onto the grass.
The grass in your hand looks tender.
I will come one step closer, just one.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的鼻子发痒。
lines.en: That smell tickles my nose.
Set the grass down, then back away.

lines.zh: 群里没人先动，我也不敢。
lines.en: Nobody in the herd moved, so I dare not.
I eat only grass, nothing else.
Is this basket enough for the whole herd?

lines.zh: 你的手指别碰到我的嘴。
lines.en: Keep your fingers away from my mouth.
I smell grass cut this morning.
Tasty as it is, I run once I finish.

lines.zh: 嫩草在那边，别拿它逗我。
lines.en: The tender grass is that way — don't tease me with it.
On the savanna I clear three meters a hop.

lines.zh: 那桶水一晃，我就迈不动腿。
lines.en: One slosh of that bucket and my legs lock.

lines.zh: 我这对角，轻轻一顶就够。
lines.en: These horns only need a light nudge.

lines.zh: 雨后的蘑菇味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of mushrooms after rain drifts over.

lines.zh: 一捧盐土，我舔一口就好。
lines.en: A handful of salt earth — one lick is enough.
I only leap. I do not bite.
The dew on these grass tips is sweet.

lines.zh: 一只被追，全群眨眼就跑没。
lines.en: Chase one, and the whole herd vanishes.
That tender leaf — one bite.
You bumped me and I jumped.
Sorry, my hooves could not stop.
Now we are all tangled together.
You are pressing down on my hoof.
I give you half a step; go on.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌碰响了我的角。
lines.en: Your shield clanged against my horn.
The whole herd scattered because of you.
Slow down; I am frailer than I look.
I spring back, then stand my ground.
Running off after a bump is rude.
Careful — these horns are hard.
Stones trip me, and so do you.
You scattered my little herd.

lines.zh: 我这副细骨架经不起撞。
lines.en: This slender frame can’t take a hit.

lines.zh: 撞一下，惊得我跳开老远。
lines.en: One bump sends me bounding away.
One bump and I want to bolt.

lines.zh: 你踩乱了我刚踩出的蹄印。
lines.en: You scuffed the hoofprints I just made.
You tripped my hooves.
Those are my longest horns.

lines.zh: 你比草原上的旋风还莽。
lines.en: You’re rougher than a savanna whirlwind.

lines.zh: 我得先确定草原够安全。
lines.en: First I must be sure the savanna is safe.
Horns touch horns, and that is a yes.

lines.zh: 母羚在最密的草丛里等我。
lines.en: The doe waits in the thickest grass.
Not now; there is a shadow far off.
The season is short; we are all eager.

lines.zh: 我的小羚将来要跑得更快。
lines.en: My fawn must outrun me someday.
Do not stare; this is private.
We circle slowly, closing the gap.

lines.zh: 草原上活着，得先有后代。
lines.en: On the savanna, offspring come first.
Even short horns must have their contest.
The grass here is tall enough to hide us.
Closer. The wind is too loud.

lines.zh: 你身上的草味让我腿软。
lines.en: The grass scent on you weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 让草原的风替我们跑一趟。
lines.en: Let the savanna wind run for us.
The dry season’s coming — let’s not dawdle.
I grew an extra branch for you.
In the grass shadows, we stand side by side.
Don’t hide — the grass is in seed.
Slowly. Pollen first.

lines.zh: 草原上的两只，跑得一样快。
lines.en: Two on the savanna, running the same pace.
I cannot carry it; I only drop it.

lines.zh: 这块肉，不是我自己掉的。
lines.en: This meat did not fall off me by choice.

lines.zh: 犄角要留好，那是稀罕物。
lines.en: Keep the horn; it is a rare thing.
There is only grass in my mouth.
I licked up this drop of water.
Do not leave things by my hooves.
My horn is worth something; my life more.
Let the monkeys handle the picking up.
I will carry this grass back to the herd.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的种子，我不吃。
lines.en: I do not eat seeds that fell on the ground.

lines.zh: 草原上的东西，我先叼着。
lines.en: Whatever's on the savanna, I'll carry it.
One leap on the savanna, higher than the wind.

lines.zh: 一小把草籽，够我嚼半天。
lines.en: A small handful of seeds lasts me half a day.
Don’t watch — I’m hiding this fruit.
I sniff it before pocketing it.
This handful of grass seed is mine.
This acacia seed is mine.
This pebble is just right for my hooves.
Head down, pick it up — it’s mine.
Whoever dropped this fruit, I’ll keep it.

lines.zh: 我盯住那条逃生的坡道。
lines.en: I fix my eyes on the escape slope.
When danger comes, I trust my legs first.

lines.zh: 全群都朝同一个方向转。
lines.en: The whole herd turns one way.

lines.zh: 我找到最薄的那段灌木。
lines.en: I found the thinnest stretch of brush.
Whoever blocks me gets shoved aside.

lines.zh: 角尖朝前，是最后的手段。
lines.en: Horns forward are my last resort.

lines.zh: 我需要一条没有绊脚石的路。
lines.en: I need a path without stumbling stones.
I can clear that slope over there.
My heartbeat has reached my ears.
One goal only: get out of here.
Every grass blade bends toward you.

lines.zh: 草原上，我闻到你踩过的草。
lines.en: On the savanna, I smell the grass you stepped on.
You’ve startled the whole herd.
The savanna wind moved first.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草，还带着汗味。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on still smells of sweat.
On the savanna, I jump highest.
The grass stirs — I’m on it.

lines.zh: 影子落到我脚前，就是现在。
lines.en: The shadow reaches my hooves — now.

lines.zh: 草原上我一跳，你就看不见我。
lines.en: One bound on the savanna and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我的细腿跑起来才叫快。
lines.en: These slender legs are made for speed.
I run; you cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我能听见你踩草的声音。
lines.en: I can hear you crushing grass.

lines.zh: 你越来越近了，我要加速。
lines.en: You are closing in; I must speed up.
I turn, and your arrow falls behind.
Do not think I fear you; I fear pain.
The rest of the herd is in your way.
Four hooves land; dust rises up.
I remember the stones on this path.

lines.zh: 你追得越急，我绕得越弯。
lines.en: The harder you chase, the more I zigzag.

lines.zh: 看我的尾巴，那是给你看的。
lines.en: Watch my tail; that is for you.

lines.zh: 你往哪拐，我的蹄就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you turn, my hooves follow.

lines.zh: 跑起来，连影子都追不上。
lines.en: At a run, not even my shadow keeps up.

lines.zh: 我的同伴已经绕到你前面。
lines.en: My herdmates have circled ahead of you.
Your shadow runs ahead, but your legs lag.

lines.zh: 草原这么大，你跑不出我的眼。
lines.en: The savanna is wide, but you can’t outrun my sight.
One spring of four hooves and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，不着急。
lines.en: I close in step by step, unhurried.
A cliff ahead — you should turn back.
Ten steps more and the savanna ends.

lines.zh: 我的犄角，能酿出更快的东西。
lines.en: My horn can brew something faster.
My horns only gave a small butt.
Do not push me; I kick badly.
My front hooves land with a crack.
I fight only so I can run.
That one was because you came too close.
Short horns still hurt when they hit.
I back off two steps and charge again.
I only wanted to shove you away.
My hind legs are stronger than my front.
After this blow, I run at once.

lines.zh: 角尖挑一下，你就站不稳。
lines.en: One flick of my horn and your footing fails.
One butt and you fall like dried grass.

lines.zh: 别躲，我跳得比你想得远。
lines.en: Don’t dodge — I leap farther than you think.

lines.zh: 让开，我的角要撞上来了。
lines.en: Move — my horns are coming.

lines.zh: 草原的规矩，跑慢就挨角。
lines.en: Savanna law: slow runners get the horns.
One kick from these thin legs is enough.
This kick is for the grass you crushed.
My horns arrive before my shadow.
One kick of my thin legs and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 我的后腿蹬起来，比角有用。
lines.en: My hind legs are more use than my horns.
I open my eyes in the sea of grass.
The wind carried me to this savanna.
Find the herd first, then water.
The soil under my hooves is warm.
This place carries the smell of lions.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着一对短角。
lines.en: I was born with a pair of short horns.
The grass stands taller than I am.
The first look up: the sky is blue.
I do not know the path, but I know the wind.
There is enough grass here for a season.
My hooves are not yet worn hard.

lines.zh: 群里少一个位置，我补上。
lines.en: The herd has a gap, and I fill it.
Good — this season’s grass will feed us.
The smell of soil calls me.
Let me warm my back first.

lines.zh: 我的细腿，刚学会撑住身体。
lines.en: My slender legs have just learned to hold me.
Lying so long has stiffened my legs.
I rise from the grass.
Who drove me to this spot?
First find a waterhole — my throat is dry.
So many new scents — it’s noisy.
Something moves in the distance.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看四面有没有影子。
lines.en: I wake and scan for any shadow.
Has the rainy season come? The grass is green.
The fire curls my fur.
Fire! A burnt savanna means no food!
My hooves slipped as I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 我跳得太高，落地歪了脚。
lines.en: I jumped too high and landed on a twisted hoof.
There is no grass to grab in the water.

lines.zh: 水漫到脖子，我踩不到底。
lines.en: Water to my neck — no footing below.
The blast threw me far away.
The blast flips me into the air.
An arrow grazed my ribs.
A new thorn. In me.
The spell leaves my legs numb.

lines.zh: 魔法顺着我的腿往上爬，跑不快了。
lines.en: Magic crawls up my legs; I can't run.
My belly is empty; I chew bark.
Hungry — the grass has all been grazed away.
Lightning struck the horn on my back.
Lightning struck. Still standing.
There is nothing left under my hooves.
I’m falling — my hooves find nothing.
